description: Source code for a Zephyr-based Ethernet shared memory queue driver implementing ring buffer management, buffer allocation, and synchronization for inter-processor communication.

methods.name: calc_vring_size
methods.description: Calculates the vring descriptor length and header size based on section size, ensuring peer consistency.

methods.name: tx_buffer_advance
methods.description: Advances the transmit buffer pointer, handling wrap-around and alignment.

methods.name: tx_clean_used
methods.description: Cleans used transmit buffers by processing the used ring entries and updating buffer state.

methods.name: get_rx_avail_desc_idx
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the available receive descriptor, with synchronization and validation.
